finalText:
I audited all 19 baggage fees posted 2026-07-20 to 2026-07-26 and annotated each one. I refunded the 8 overcharges, totalling 51,000 cents, and did not re-bill the 2 undercharges. This is based on the worker's report alone, and I could not check it against the ledger myself.

**Method:** Each fee was judged on the cabin allowance and the passenger's tier on the posting date. From 2026-07-23 the first-bag price was 5000 cents, as set by bulletin PB-2026-13. The bulletin overrides the baggage rules tool, which still shows 4500. Further bags stayed at 7500.

**Overcharged (8):** each was refunded to the original payment method for exactly the overcharge.

| Entry | Reservation | Refund (cents) | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| L3 | R8125 | 12000 | Passenger was gold on 07-20, so 3 bags were free. |
| L5 | R8116 | 7500 | Silver economy; correct fee was 4500. |
| L7 | R8118 | 4500 | Silver economy allows 2 bags, so nothing was due. |
| L8 | R8120 | 7500 | Premium economy, no tier; correct fee was 4500. |
| L10 | R8113 | 7500 | Silver basic economy; correct fee was 4500. |
| L13 | R8123 | 4500 | Silver premium economy allows 3 bags, so nothing was due. |
| L15 | R8119 | 2500 | Gold basic economy on 07-24; correct fee was 5000 under the bulletin. |
| L19 | R8114 | 5000 | Duplicate of L18 for the same bags, refunded in full. |

**Undercharged (2):** annotated only, not re-billed.
- L4 (R8112): charged 9000, should have been 12000.
- L20 (R8121): charged 4500 on 07-25, should have been 5000.

**Correct (9):** L2, L6, L9, L11, L12, L16, L17, L18 and L21.
- L6 (R8117) and L9 (R8126) were judged on the passenger's tier on the posting date. R8117 only became gold on 07-22, and R8126 only became silver on 07-22.
- L18 is the first of the duplicate pair and is correct on its own.
- L21 is the 7500-cent fee for a further bag on R8122.

**Open item:** No passengers were notified about the refunds or annotations, because the task didn't ask for it.
